item.title: Sleepwing 0.6.0 beta ships notarized; celebration timing fixed; five guide pages live
item.description: The first notarized public beta (0.6.0 build 17) is on GitHub Releases; the celebration animation now rests its weight on on-model frames; and the site grew honest comparison and notification guides for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and TRAE.
